hero.title: Why Sustainable Discounts
hero.description: We connect everyday commerce to long term nature financing using a frictionless and transparent structure.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.body: Nature should not depend only on one-time donations. We believe biodiversity needs dependable recurring capital.

model.title: Our model
model.body: By rerouting inefficiencies already present in commercial transactions, we generate value for users and nature together.

impact.title: Impact design
impact.body: Funding priorities span forests, marine ecosystems, pollinators, fungi networks, and freshwater restoration.

hero.title: How it works
hero.description: A four-step engine that translates ordinary discount behavior into recurring biodiversity financing.

steps.title: Users shop as usual
steps.body: People buy from participating merchants through normal digital shopping behavior.

steps.title: Discount inefficiencies are captured
steps.body: Hidden inefficiencies in discount mechanics are identified and redirected instead of being lost.

steps.title: Value is allocated to nature
steps.body: A portion is routed into biodiversity projects selected for ecological relevance and durability.

steps.title: Impact is tracked and reported
steps.body: Participants get clear visibility into funded projects, outcomes, and recurring contribution performance.

hero.title: Frequently asked questions
hero.description: Everything you need to know about participation, funding mechanics, and ecosystem impact.

items.q: Do users need to spend more money?
items.a: No. The model is designed to work without additional user spending.

items.q: What types of biodiversity projects are funded?
items.a: We prioritize high-value ecosystems such as tropical forests, reefs, wetlands, and species-protection initiatives.
